summary: Russian forces claim to have shot down 100 Ukrainian drones over Black and Azov Sea regions in the past 12 hours. Ukraine is requesting Patriot missiles from 40 countries following Russian attacks that caused power outages across multiple regions. Drone activity reported across Chernihiv, Dnipropetrovsk, Donets, Kharkiv, and other areas with various directional movements.
key_points: Russian Ministry of Defense claims 100 Ukrainian drones shot down over Black and Azov Seas in 12 hours (Source: @tass_agency/383442).
Ukraine requested Patriot missiles from 40 countries following Russian attacks causing widespread power outages (Source: @UkraineNow/82353).
Shahed drone crossed from Chernihiv to Kyiv regions, Brovarskyi district (Source: @mon1tor_ua/68495).
Two drones struck near Apostolovoye-Zelenodolskaya in Dnipropetrovshchyna (Source: @eRadarrua/99427).
Russian strike destroyed book warehouse in Kiev, burning 800,000 books (Source: @UkraineNow/82344).
Power outages affected Kiev, Donets, Zaporizhzhia, and Kharkiv regions due to Russian attacks (Source: @UkraineNow/82329).
Russian Army Group 'East' took control of Kopany settlement in Zaporozhye region (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31316).
Ukraine plans competition to create humanoid robots for Armed Forces to minimize troop risks (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31346).

sections.executive_summary: Russian forces claim to have shot down 100 Ukrainian drones over Black and Azov Sea regions in the past 12 hours. Ukraine is requesting Patriot missiles from 40 countries following Russian attacks causing power outages across multiple regions. Drone activity reported across Chernihiv, Dnipropetrovsk, Donets, Kharkiv, and other areas with various directional movements.

points: Ukraine requested Patriot missiles from 40 countries following Russian attacks that caused power outages across Kiev, Donets, Zaporizhzhia, and Kharkiv regions. The situation remains difficult in Sumshchyna where the largest number of consumers are disconnected (Source: @UkraineNow/82353, @UkraineNow/82329).

Russian strike destroyed book warehouse in central Kiev logistics facility, burning 800,000 books from publishing house BookChef. The attack targeted Denka Logistics facility where books were stored, potentially causing delays in order fulfillment (Source: @UkraineNow/82344).

Kiev residents spent the night in metro during air raid warnings. The underground transportation system served as shelter for civilians during Russian drone and missile attacks (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31319).

Ukraine plans competition to create humanoid robots for the Ukrainian Armed Forces. Defense Minister Fedorov announced the initiative to minimize risks for troops during combat missions and rotations on front lines (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31346).

SBU and Polish police identified 11 individuals organizing paid anti-Ukrainian protests in EU cities funded by Russia. The individuals included 2 Belarusians and 9 Ukrainians who were deported to their home countries (Source: @UkraineNow/82342).

Russian Ministry of Defense claimed 100 Ukrainian drones shot down over Black and Azov Sea regions in 12 hours. The statement was made through official TASS agency reporting (Source: @tass_agency/383442).

Russian forces struck factory in Kiev producing control systems for 'Flamingo' and 'Fire Point' missiles. The Defense Ministry reported this attack on Ukrainian military infrastructure (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31321).
Russian tactical aviation activity reported on northeast, east, and southeast directions. Threat of aviation weapons use for frontline regions was noted (Source: @kpszsu/67119).
Cruise missile activity reported on Poltava direction, Dikanka area. Radar detected cruise rockets in Poltava region (Source: @eRadarrua/99366).

Russian Army Group 'East' took control of Kopany settlement in Zaporozhye region. Two civilian vehicles attacked on Dneprovka-Zapovitnoe road, and multiple civilian injuries reported in various settlements (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31316).
Drone activity reported at boundary of Donets and Kharkiv regions moving toward Barvinok. Multiple drone groups active in the area (Source: @kpszsu/67148).
Drone activity reported near Krasnokutsk moving southwest in Kharkivshchyna (Source: @kpszsu/67129).
Drone activity reported toward Dikanki from northeast of Poltava (Source: @kpszsu/67170).
Shahed drone crossed from Chernihiv to Kyiv regions, Brovarskyi district. Two Shahed drones also flying from Chernihiv to Kyiv region, Vyshgorodskyi district (Source: @mon1tor_ua/68495).
Drone activity reported in Chernihivshchyna with 8 groups near Romny-Nedryhailiv and 4 from Trostianch near Nedryhailiv (Source: @eRadarrua/99442).
Drone activity reported in Chernihivshchyna with 2 Ripky, 8 groups from Sumshchyna via Romny toward Dikanki, 1 Lipovaya Dolina, 2 Lebedyn, 1 Stepanivka (Source: @eRadarrua/99441).
Drone activity reported in Mykolaivshchyna with drones from sea moving toward Ochakiv (Source: @kpszsu/67154).
Drone activity reported toward Novomikolaivka in Zaporizhzhia region from south (Source: @kpszsu/67160).
Drone activity reported toward Bozhedarivka in Zaporizhzhia region from southeast (Source: @kpszsu/67174).
Two drones reported near Apostolovoye-Zelenodolskaya in Dnipropetrovshchyna (Source: @eRadarrua/99427).
Russian cruise missile activity reported on Poltava direction, Dikanka area (Source: @eRadarrua/99366).
Multiple drone groups active across various regions with different directional movements. Kabis activity reported on Dnipropetrovsk and Zaporizhzhia regions (Source: @kpszsu/67167).
Two drones reported over Black Sea waters near Kosi and far from Crimean Peninsula, three different types of drones in Kherson (Source: @eRadarrua/99427).
Russian tactical aviation threat reported for northeast, east, and southeast directions with potential weapon use against frontline areas (Source: @kpszsu/67119).

sections.threat_assessment: Russian forces maintain active drone and aviation campaigns across multiple fronts with particular focus on infrastructure and civilian areas. The claim of shooting down 100 drones suggests continued air defense pressure on Ukrainian forces. Power grid attacks have created humanitarian concerns with civilian casualties reported in energy infrastructure work. Russian advances in Zaporozhye region indicate ongoing ground operations with territorial gains.
sections.regional_response: Ukraine's request for Patriot missiles from 40 countries indicates urgent air defense needs following sustained Russian attacks. The SBU and Polish police operation exposing Russian-funded protests demonstrates counter-intelligence success against hybrid warfare. Ukraine's robotics initiative shows adaptation to personnel shortages and combat risks. International attention on Ukrainian internal political struggles may complicate Western support efforts.
sections.intelligence_notes: Russian drone claims should be verified through independent sources given frequent exaggeration in military statements. The pattern of drone activity shows coordinated multi-axis operations across northern and southern regions. Civilian infrastructure targeting continues with measurable humanitarian impact. Intelligence sharing about Russian-funded disinformation operations in EU represents effective counter-propaganda efforts.
